data.description:
June 19–20, 2026 UTC URLQuery records show an account workflow spanning disposable email, Browserless authentication, token refresh and browser-service provisioning attempts. A June 19 11:06:08.747 Mail.gw account-creation POST returns 201. Recorded mailbox output later contains two Browserless verification-email metadata entries; the second is dated one second after the observed OTP request. Their text intros stop before the actual code.

At June 19 23:40:36.265, the Browserless email-verification POST returns 200. All 2,186 bytes of the authentication JSON are recoverable from a subsequent recorded output URL and match the original response's size and SHA-256. Returned refresh credentials exactly recur as inputs to later programs, and new credentials recur again across refreshes. A June 20 03:06:41.890 GraphQL POST carries the earlier returned access token and returns 200. The source requests signupCloudUnits, but the 226-byte GraphQL response body is unavailable, so success versus an application error remains unresolved.

The deduplicated reviewed sequence comprises 65 Browserless-related encoded programs—six authentication/refresh programs and 59 provisioning programs—plus four linked mailbox programs, totaling 69 reports. These are not 69 accounts. The same mailbox earlier received a URLQuery verification email, but URLQuery activation and API-key issuance are not established by this particular chain. A separate Microlink API-key case is reported independently.

The later consolidation recovered full logs that supersede early title-only or pending descriptions. It confirms mailbox creation, successful Browserless authentication and exact credential continuity. It does not recover the complete OTP email or prove how the embedded verification code was obtained. A controller passing results between scans is strongly supported; whether that controller was a person, script or AI agent is unknown. Successful Browserless provisioning, usable automation credits/API access and a later remote browser session remain unproved. The returned auth-user creation timestamp also predates the observed OTP request, so that request should not be described as the first creation event. Account provisioning alone is not evidence of abuse; cyberattack is None. No mailbox addresses, OTPs, tokens or credential-bearing links are included here, and none was tested.
data.summary: June 19–20: a scan-mediated workflow created a Mail.gw mailbox, verified Browserless email authentication and reused returned credentials in refreshes and provisioning attempts. Authentication is verified; working browser provisioning and the full OTP-read step are not.
